description.p1: I developed a passion for technology since I was a child. Over the years, I explored this vast universe, starting with Computer Engineering (I studied until the 5th semester).
description.p2: Looking for improvement in the Technology and Languages, I had the opportunity to take English and Web Development in Canada, I experienced a great experience living in a wonderful country welcoming having contact with colleagues from various countries for 02 years.
description.p3: I graduated in 2024 at Tamwood Careers in Vancouver, Canada, where I had the opportunity through the cooperative system, to work in my area as a Freelancer more than 480 hours, where I acquired skills with Web Developer | PHP | HTML| CSS | Bootstrap | JavaScript | Python | HTML | CSS | MySQL | Frontend. With Diploma in Web Development.
description.p4: I am a dedicated and committed professional, always looking for innovation and continuous learning. I like to face complex challenges and find creative and efficient solutions to the problems I encounter.
description.p5: My goal is to contribute to interesting projects and be part of a dynamic team that shares a passion for technology. I firmly believe that continuous learning is essential for professional growth, and I'm always looking for opportunities to expand my knowledge and skills.
description.p6: Recently I returned to Brazil, and I am continuing my Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering and I am ready for new challenges.
